name: SeekMake – Instant 3D Printing Quote Plugin on your Website
author: seekmake

sections.description:
SeekMake – 3D Printing Quoting Plugin for WordPress

Turn your WordPress website into an automated 3D printing shop.

With SeekMake, your customers can upload their 3D models and instantly receive a price for printing — without waiting for emails or manual quotes.

SeekMake is a powerful plugin that can be easily implemented on any website to provide instant 3D printing prices, streamline payments, order management, and customer communication — powered by AI.

Perfect for:
* 3D printing services
* Makerspaces
* Print farms
* Prototyping companies
* Online 3D print shops

🚀 How It Works

  1. Customer uploads an STL file.
  2. SeekMake analyzes the model (volume, print time, material).
  3. A price is calculated automatically.
  4. Customer places the order and pays online.

More quotes. More orders. Less manual work.

⚙️ Easy Setup

Step 1 – Install Plugin
Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.

Step 2 – Connect to SeekMake
Go to SeekMake in your WordPress admin menu and click “Connect Your Account” to authenticate.

Step 3 – Add Widgets (Shortcode or Elementor)
You can use the Instant Quote or Client Dashboard widgets.

Option A: Using Shortcodes
Insert these on any page:
* Instant Quote: [seekmake_instant_quote]
* Client Dashboard: [seekmake_client_dashboard]

Option B: Using Elementor
Edit a page and search for “SeekMake” in the widgets panel.

Done ✅

✨ Main Features

🧠 Smart Pricing

  • Instant 3D printing quotes
  • Automatic volume & print time calculation
  • Material & color selection
  • Infill & support material calculation
  • Filament cost calculation

🖥️ 3D Model Viewer

  • Rotate and inspect STL files
  • Zoom in / zoom out
  • Scale models
  • Manual rotation

💳 Orders & Payments

  • Online payments (Stripe, manual invoice, bank transfer)
  • Automatic order creation
  • Customer dashboard
  • Order tracking

🤖 Automation

  • Automatic email notifications
  • AI sales assistant (optional)
  • Customer qualification
  • Low maintenance system

📊 Business Tools

  • Quote history
  • Customer management
  • Analytics & reports

🎨 Customization

  • Place anywhere with shortcode
  • Mobile responsive
  • Multi-language ready
  • Custom pricing rules

🛟 Support

📩 contact@seekmake.com

📄 License

Licensed under GPL v3 or later.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to external SeekMake services:

Services Used:
* Authentication: dev.seekmake.com/auth/login
* Dashboard: seekmake.com/dashboard/manufacturer/
* API: dev.seekmake.com

Data Transmitted:
* User authentication credentials (during login only)
* Manufacturer ID (stored in WordPress options)
* Customer quote requests (CAD files, specifications)
* Order and project information

Data Storage:
* WordPress stores: Manufacturer ID, authentication status
* SeekMake stores: User accounts, quotes, orders, customer data

User Consent:
By activating this plugin and connecting your SeekMake account, you consent to data transmission to SeekMake services. No tracking or analytics occur without explicit consent.

For complete privacy details, visit: https://seekmake.com/privacy-policy

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on SeekMake’s external services:

SeekMake Platform
* Service: Manufacturing quoting and order management
* Website: https://seekmake.com
* Terms of Service: https://seekmake.com/terms-and-conditions
* Privacy Policy: https://seekmake.com/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to SeekMake’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Support

For support, please visit:
* Documentation: https://seekmake.com/developers-portal/api-docs
* Support: https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=37258190825
* Help Center: https://seekmake.com/contact-us

sections.faq:
Do I need a SeekMake account?

Yes, a SeekMake account is required. You can create one for free at seekmake.com or during the plugin setup process.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is completely free. SeekMake operates as a Software as a Service platform with its own pricing for manufacturing services.

What file formats are supported for quotes?

The Instant Quote widget supports STEP, STL, DXF, and other common CAD file formats.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes! Both widgets offer customization options including colors, button styles, and display modes (inline, modal, or button).

Will this work with my theme?

Yes, SeekMake is designed to work with any WordPress theme. It’s fully compatible with popular page builders like Elementor.

How do I disconnect my account?

Go to SeekMake > Dashboard in your WordPress admin and click the “Disconnect” button in the header. You can reconnect at any time.

Where is my data stored?

Quote requests and order data are stored securely on SeekMake’s servers. Your WordPress site only stores your Manufacturer ID and authentication status.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all data transmission uses HTTPS encryption. SeekMake follows industry-standard security practices. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Can customers track their orders?

Yes! The Client Dashboard widget provides customers with real-time order tracking, quote history, and invoice downloads.

What WordPress version do I need?

WordPress 5.0 or higher is required. The plugin has been tested up to WordPress 6.7.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher is required for optimal performance and security.
